note: New suite authored alongside the research-specialist agent + rubric (gh#721, lld-0023). Positives cover dispatching the agent, authoring/reviewing its deliverable, and grading it against the rubric. Negatives are adversarial against the closest neighbors: harness:fact-finder (gather-only, no synthesis), research-methods/experiment-runner (fixed-scorer measured loop), make-rubric (general rubric authoring), check-doc/doc-checker (generic document review with no deliverable-schema angle).
